annotations.title: End a site's maintenance windows now

description: Wraps POST /api/sites/{slug}/maintenance/end. End a site's maintenance windows now. Call this after a deploy: alerts for the site go out again from now. Ending with no window on answers `ended: 0`. It acts for the whole team. Needs a Member or Admin key, on a team with 10 sites or more.
name: sites_by_slug_maintenance_end
